audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart on disk (Skill, Akali, Akali, Skill, Skill, Akali, Akali) matches neither the packet chart nor the why-text sitting beside it: phases[0].why says you win level 1 outright but the side was 'Skill'; whys[3] and whys[4] describe Akali's shroud and ult windows but those rows were marked 'Skill'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart at 51.63% over 707 games is Gragas, Skill, Skill, Akali, Akali, Skill, Gragas — and rows 0 through 4 of that chart agree exactly with the existing content whys. The on-disk chart is the outlier.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Gragas / Skill / Skill / Akali / Akali / Skill / Gragas with ratings 7,5,5,4,4,5,7, and the why-text on the changed rows rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item and two-item phases carried the generic 'Riftmaker is your spike / your side-lane pattern is at full power' boilerplate, which contradicts every other line on the page saying she out-scales you.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s and Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s — the ult cooldown halving is her real scaling spike. Explosive Cask drops to 70s at rank 3, which is what makes the late game yours in a fight rather than a duel.
audit.corrected: phases[5] keys the first-item window to Twilight Shroud's 20s cooldown; phases[6] and whys[6] state plainly that she wins the duel while your Cask peel and Body Slam into her R dash line win the teamfight.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[1].d were all generic template strings — no ability named, no number, and every one of them referred to Akali as 'he' and 'his'. dontsFull[1] was titled 'Fight her 6 with no MR' but its body described burning an ultimate.
audit.why: Barrel Roll reaches 850 against her 550-range Five Point Strike, so the poke range is the level-1 edge. Drunken Rage is a 5s damage reduction plus auto-reset. Body Slam is 14s at rank 1, not the 13 the template claimed. Perfect Execution's second cast executes, which is what makes an MR-less level 6 lethal rather than merely painful.
audit.corrected: Those four fields now name Barrel Roll, Drunken Rage, Body Slam (14s), Twilight Shroud (20s) and Perfect Execution (120s at rank 1), in second person and with the pronouns fixed.

audit.why: All four packet suspectNames ('Drop Twilight Shroud', 'Once Twilight Shroud', 'No Twilight Shroud', "Twilight Shroud's") are false positives — the fuzzy matcher is catching the leading word or the possessive. The mirror audit recorded the same false-positive pattern on its side.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins level 1 outright. Identify how Akali contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Barrel Roll out-ranges her 550-range Q at level 1 and she has no Twilight Shroud yet to hide in. Poke and bank the lead.

edits.before: W damage reduction + sustain flips his return trade. Only take the trade when Akali's Twilight Shroud is down.
edits.after: Drunken Rage (5s) damage reduction and Happy Hour flip her return poke, but her passive proc answers back — even trade.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akali must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kits both ways: your E-W-Q is online and so is Twilight Shroud (20s) to blank part of it. Whoever reads it wins.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Twilight Shroud's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker matches her first-item burst — fight only on Twilight Shroud's 20s cooldown.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Akali carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: She wins a sidelane duel, so stop taking it: Explosive Cask peel and Body Slam into her R dash line win the teamfight for you.

edits.before: Q-poke Akali on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Barrel Roll from fog angles, Drunken Rage as she answers, Body Slam only once Twilight Shroud (20s) is spent.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body Slam into the Shroud — a whiffed E is 14 seconds of standing there with no escape.

edits.before: Q-poke Akali on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Mercury's Treads plus tenacity cuts her Q slow and her burst — buy it before her first item lands.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Perfect Execution (120s at rank 1) executes — stay above the line.

edits.before: Riftmaker and Happy Hour let you out-sustain the trades she opens from Shroud: force the all-in the moment your first item completes.
edits.after: Riftmaker and Happy Hour out-sustain the trades she opens from Shroud, but her first item matches it — it comes down to the Shroud read.

edits.before: She out-scales hard: full-AP Akali Shroud-resets and one-shots, so stop dueling and use Explosive Cask to peel her off your team.
edits.after: She wins the pure 1v1, but you win the fight: Explosive Cask (70s at rank 3) knocks her off a reset and Body Slam blocks her R dash line.

notes: Level-chart flips proposed as one atomic group across both layers, aligned to packet.levelChart. Rows 0-4 of the packet chart already agreed with the existing content whys, which is why I trusted it over the disk chart. Row 6 (Gragas) is the one row where the packet and the prose pulled apart — the prose said she out-scales — so I kept the packet side and reframed the text as duel-vs-teamfight, which is true of both champions and invents nothing. Note the template had Body Slam at '13 seconds'; the kit says 14/13.5/13/12.5/12, so 13s is rank 3, not rank 1.
